prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual full-body transparent 2D fighting-game action sprite of ABSTRACTING RAGATHA. Reference 1 is the approved strict design lock for silhouette, proportions, exact transformation patches, eyes, colours and polished cel shading. Reference 2 supplies official design details only; do not imitate its squat toy proportions, setting or lighting. Ragatha with blue bow, red yarn hair on normal side, blue button eye, blue patchwork dress with white collar/hem, pale cloth hands, one normal black shoe. Opposing side of head and one leg are black angular crystal with concentric pastel eyes; the dark face has a multicoloured eye-like curved smile, exactly as selection and official source. Crystal growth belongs to her anatomical RIGHT shoulder (viewer-left in frontal selection); her anatomical LEFT shoulder retains the rounded normal blue sleeve. Preserve this shoulder placement, asymmetry and costume; do not swap anatomical sides or restore normal face. Create a genuinely distinct natural action pose, not a mirrored/cropped selection image. Every limb, crown/hat/ear tip, attached mask and crystal spike must fit fully inside clear transparent margins on ALL sides. One connected character, crisp detailed 2D art on true transparent RGBA; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, glow, particles, labels, watermark, inset or duplicate. POSE: WALK toward screen RIGHT: natural long stride with one foot forward and opposing arm swing, rear heel lifting, torso balanced. Distinct walking pose, not neutral standing.
WALK GAIT CORRECTION: the NORMAL anatomical RIGHT LEG with the black shoe strides FORWARD toward screen RIGHT. The CRYSTALLINE anatomical LEFT LEG trails BACK toward screen LEFT. At the same time, the anatomical LEFT ARM with the normal rounded blue shoulder sleeve swings FORWARD toward screen RIGHT, while the anatomical RIGHT ARM whose shoulder is crystal swings BACK toward screen LEFT. This is natural opposing-arm/opposing-leg walking. Preserve the anatomical transformations; do not swap the crystal shoulder or leg to the other side.

portableReferences.restoreInstruction: The exact reference is archived in this repository. If unavailable, download the named official image URL, verify and visually inspect it before generation. For an expired storyboard URL, refresh the storyboard through the official episode player metadata.

observations: Corrected natural stride toward screen right: normal anatomical-right leg/black shoe leads while the crystal left leg trails; the normal blue-sleeved left arm swings forward while the crystal-shouldered right arm swings back. This restores opposing-arm/opposing-leg gait without changing the transformation sides. Complete bow, hair, dress, hands and both feet remain visible.
Native RGBA and clear threshold-12 contour margins verified; source bytes unchanged.
visualReview.scope: Approved reference identity and sprite technical fit; not canonical episode certification.
